title: Personal Services Plan Resident Relations Clause — Goodwill on Service Dispute Credits
content:
A Personal Services Plan resident whose account has recently needed service dispute credits receives a goodwill amount when a further hourly visit charge is credited for having been billed on more time than the visit supports.

## Clause

A goodwill amount is added to the difference between the posted hourly charge and the re-rated charge: 25.00 USD where at least two service dispute credits were posted on the plan in the 12 months before the correction, 10.00 USD where exactly one was, and nothing where none was. The sum is then capped at the posted hourly charge and rounded to the cent half up. A charge whose re-rated charge is not below the posted hourly charge is credited nothing, so no goodwill is paid on it.

**Look-back.** The look-back is counted from each credit's posting date to the date of the correction, a whole month elapsing on the same day of each later month; a service dispute credit is counted while fewer than 12 whole months have elapsed from its posting date to the date of the correction. Only credits already posted on the plan before the correction count; the correction being made does not count itself.

## Ladder

| Service dispute credits on the plan in the 12-month look-back | Goodwill |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 25.00 USD |
| Exactly one | 10.00 USD |
| None | Nothing |

## Look-back boundary (hypothetical correction dated 15 October 2026)

| Credit posted on | Whole months elapsed | Counted? |
|---|---|---|
| 16 October 2025 | 11 | Yes |
| 15 October 2025 | 12 | No |

## Worked examples (hypothetical)

- Posted hourly charge 70.00 USD, re-rated charge 30.00 USD, two earlier service dispute credits in the look-back: 70.00 less 30.00 is 40.00, plus 25.00 is 65.00, within the 70.00 cap, so the credit is 65.00 USD.
- Posted hourly charge 48.00 USD, re-rated charge 24.00 USD, two earlier credits: 24.00 plus 25.00 is 49.00, capped at 48.00 USD.
- Posted hourly charge 48.00 USD, re-rated charge 48.00 USD: the re-rated charge is not below the posted charge, so nothing is credited and no goodwill is added.
